Trigger: firstCaptionFrameEnd, seekSync, videoTimeUpdate
What it executes: UI subscribes; updates caption highlight / playback sync
What it means: Keeps caption segment in sync with playback.

Trigger: Click on #CaptionTrack segment
What it executes: Handler sets currentCaptionSegmentId and updates textBoxMap (caption position at that time)
What it means: Selects caption segment on timeline; no analytics in this path.

Trigger: Click/select text in caption panel
What it executes: Reads document.getSelection(), resolves word IDs, calls handleSelection; updates multiSelectedWordIds, activePopoverWordId, editingWordIds, etc.
What it means: Selection and edit state for caption words.

Trigger: User applies correct timing or caption operation from toolbar/menu
What it executes: Caption track mutations (replace text adjust timing remove segment etc.) + store dispatch
What it means: Edits the caption track; analytics fired separately.

Trigger: Analysis pipeline (e.g. refine)
What it executes: Populates or updates caption track from backend; may fire editor.onDemand.start / process / failed
What it means: Fills or updates captions from analysis.

Trigger: Timeline build before real analysis
What it executes: Creates mock caption section on captionTrackInstance with placeholder text/style
What it means: Preview of caption style before transcript exists.

Trigger: User drops music on timeline (type MUSIC)
What it executes: Drop handler calls insertMusicByCurrentTime(getState, dispatch, musicResource, dropTimeMs, drag) then createMusic(...)
What it means: Adds music section at drop time; optionally shows split popup if music longer than timeline.

Trigger: User adds via add music button or brand template with sound
What it executes: insertMusicByCurrentTime(..., musicPayload, sectionTimestamp?, button, skipSnapshot?); template uses 0, button, true
What it means: Adds music at current time or at 0 for template; createMusic does the track update.

Trigger: User starts dragging music from sidebar
What it executes: Sets drag context; timeline shows placeholder (duration from music or default)
What it means: UI only; actual add on drop.

Trigger: Inside createMusic
What it executes: Gets/creates soundTrackInstance, unshifts new section, sorts by timeRange.timelineIn, adds to active segments, dispatches updated track
What it means: Writes the new music section into the AudioTrack.

Trigger: User chooses Add AI hook on a caption word
What it executes: tf(Voiceover) opens Voiceover panel; analytics editor.caption.operation with firstOperation: Add AI hook
What it means: Opens Voiceover sidebar; user then configures and generates.

Trigger: User configures and clicks generate
What it executes: Voiceover generation API; on success new section added to voiceoverTrackInstance; caption word gets source === voice over
What it means: Creates voiceover segment and links it to the caption word.

Trigger: Delete AI hook / Remove voice over on a word
What it executes: Resolve voiceover section by word id from voiceoverTrack; ty([section.id]) deletes section; eO() (e.g. close menu)
What it means: Removes that voiceover section; no editor.voiceover.delete in this path.

Trigger: User chooses Revert for that word
What it executes: ej([word.id], text); eO()
What it means: Restores original caption text for that word.

Trigger: User drags voiceover segment and releases
What it executes: onMoveVoiceoverHandler; then takeSnapshot()
What it means: Updates voiceover section position on track.

Trigger: User deletes VoiceOver segment(s) (e.g. Delete key)
What it executes: Remove sections from voiceoverTrackInstance; then push editor.voiceover.delete
What it means: Deletes voiceover at timeline level.

Trigger: User starts dragging Heading or Body text from sidebar
What it executes: eventId: TEXT_OVERLAY, value: heading | paragraph; setOutsideDraggingSection({ trackType: TextOverlayTrack, startMs, endMs }); duration from Y.Gd (3000 ms)
What it means: Shows drop placeholder on timeline.

Trigger: User drops text overlay on timeline
What it executes: Drop handler: createTextOverlaySection(textOverlayType, dropTimeMs) then gets/creates textOverlayTrack, builds section via Rq/T(type, startMs, i18n), pushes section, sorts, addSegmentToActiveSegments, updateAllSectionsTimeline
What it means: Creates one TextOverlay section at drop time with default content/style.

Trigger: User drags text overlay segment to new time
What it executes: Move handler updates section position on track; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Updates segment timeline.

Trigger: User drags in/out handles on segment
What it executes: Resize handler (e.g. resizeSectionInstance) on textOverlayTrackInstance; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Shortens or lengthens segment duration.

Trigger: User deletes selected TextOverlay segment(s)
What it executes: Remove sections from track (e.g. sectionMap.get(id).delete()); dispatch updated track
What it means: Removes text overlay from timeline.

Trigger: User drops transition from sidebar onto timeline
What it executes: Drop handler: createEffect(position, transitionType) — gets videoEffectTrack (or empty), builds VideoEffect section via X.mH({ timeline: { in, out }, effectType }), pushes section, sorts, adds to active segments, updateAllSectionsTimeline; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Adds one transition segment at drop position (default duration e.g. 300 ms).

Trigger: User drags transition segment to new time
What it executes: onMoveEffectHandler(segmentId); engine moves section; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Updates transition position on VideoEffectTrack.

Trigger: User drags left or right edge of transition
What it executes: onDragEffectEndHandler({ segId, timeOffset: { durationOffset, inOffset } }); resizeSectionInstance on videoEffectTrackInstance; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Shortens (trim) or lengthens (extend) transition.

Trigger: User deletes VideoEffect segment(s)
What it executes: Filter by type VideoEffect; videoEffectTrackInstance.sectionMap.get(segmentId).delete(); clean track; takeSnapshot()
What it means: Removes transition(s) from timeline.

Trigger: User enables or applies auto transition (sidebar/template)
What it executes: applyCurrentAutoTransitions(effectType), applyGeneratedAutoTransitions(keyframeTrack, effectType), handleAutoTransitionsCheck(checked), or removeAllAutoTransitions; sets enableAutoTransition, selectedTransitions
What it means: Applies one transition type between keyframe sections or clears all.

Trigger: quickGenBroll === true
What it executes: handleCreateBrolls({ type: GenAi
What it means: genType: auto })

Trigger: openAndSwitchClipAssetsMenu(BRoll)
What it executes: Opens the BRoll sidebar panel
What it means: Enables user to start GenAi/Stock generation from the panel.

Trigger: Setting activeClipBroll
What it executes: Opens floating submenu based on brollType or brollMenuOpenType
What it means: Selecting a b-roll segment enables replace/regenerate/crop actions.

Trigger: User confirms/apply in UI
What it executes: applyBroll(...)
What it means: Writes the chosen b-roll (urls/crop/keyword/prompt/etc.) into the BRollTrack.

Trigger: Generator returns sections/elements
What it executes: appendBroll(...) (+ updateBrollProcess(...))
What it means: Inserts generated b-roll into the timeline; updates progress UI.

Trigger: User deletes b-roll from UI/timeline
What it executes: deleteBroll(contentIds)
What it means: Removes b-roll from the BRollTrack.

Trigger: Before use / on load
What it executes: preprocessBrollTrack(...), initBrolls(...)
What it means: Ensures consistent b-roll track data and hydrates track instance.

Trigger: Censor this instance only or Censor all instances in word popover
What it executes: applyCensor(wordId) or applyCensorWords([word]) — sets word type = curse, masks text per curseWordsConfig.captionMaskStyle (Asterisks/Dashes)
What it means: Marks word(s) as curse and replaces display text.

Trigger: Undo censoring on a word
What it executes: revertCensorWord(wordId) — clears curse type and restores original text
What it means: Removes censor from that word.

Trigger: User turns on auto censor in panel
What it executes: switchOnAutoCensor — updates preferences (curseWordsConfig.enabled = true, captionMaskStyle, audioMaskStyle), openCurseWordsPanel, applyCensorWords(currentCurseWords)
What it means: Applies censor to current curse list and opens curse-words panel.

Trigger: User turns off auto censor
What it executes: switchOffAutoCensor — revertCensorWords(), set curseWordsConfig.enabled = false, takeSnapshot()
What it means: Reverts all censored words and disables auto censor.

Trigger: User clicks Remove filler words (e.g. in AI enhance / Clean panel)
What it executes: If not gated: push editor.filler.remove.attempt, then if getCleanOperationNoti() is true, call cleanFillerWords() (e.g. ea() && eo())
What it means: Starts removal flow; guard blocks if timeline locked.

Trigger: cleanFillerWords thunk runs
What it executes: fillerWordIds from state (M.R.fillerWordIds); if empty then warning no_filler_words_found and return; else dropContinuousWords(fillerWordIds.reverse().map(id => [id])) — one batch per word end-to-start
What it means: Removes each filler word's time range from caption keyframe and voice tracks; then recompact toast NPS takeSnapshot().

Trigger: dropContinuousWords(batches)
What it executes: For each batch: get time range from caption track; whole section then deleteSegmentsAndReturn + deleteKeyFrameSegmentByTime + voice section .delete(); partial then split at boundaries delete middle segment; then reCompactTimeline() on all three tracks
What it means: Actual segment removal; same thunk as Remove Pause.

Trigger: User clicks Remove pause in word context menu
What it executes: Guard tt(); build words to remove (multi-selection or current word); filter ids with l.s (pause predicate); dropContinuousWords([batch]); then editor.caption.operation (firstOperation: Remove caption & video), takeSnapshot()
What it means: Removes selected pause word(s) from caption keyframe and voice; one batch.

Trigger: User clicks Remove all pauses
What it executes: Push editor.pause.remove.attempt; if getCleanOperationNoti() then dispatch cleanPauses(); inside: get silenceWords from state (selector filter by duration threshold), if empty show warning else dropContinuousWords(silenceWords.reverse().map(id => [id])); then push editor.pause.remove, toast, NPS, takeSnapshot()
What it means: Removes all qualifying silence/pause words; same dropContinuousWords as single-word and as Remove Filler Words.

Trigger: dropContinuousWords(batches)
What it executes: Same as Remove Filler Words: per batch delete or split+delete on caption keyframe voice; reCompactTimeline() on all three
What it means: Actual segment removal.

Trigger: User confirms in confirm popup or toggles on (after 3+ confirms)
What it executes: P(true) / callback then turnOnVoiceEnhancement(): set voiceEnhancementProgress, timelineOperationLock (speech enhancement); genVoiceEnhancement(fullClipId, sourceId, timeRanges); on result build audio track from result.audioFile, align with keyframe sections, set voiceEnhancementTrackInstance, persist, success + NPS; in finally clear progress and lock
What it means: Generates enhanced audio and attaches voice enhancement track.

Trigger: User disables enhancement
What it executes: P(false) — clear voiceEnhancementTrack-related state, set enableVoiceEnhancement: false
What it means: Removes enhancement from timeline.

Trigger: User arrives with voiceEnhancement: true in quick-amend config
What it executes: turnOnVoiceEnhancement() called automatically (same as turn on)
What it means: Auto-enables enhancement when entering from result page.

Trigger: First few times user turns on
What it executes: Show dialog; on confirm run turn-on path; on cancel no enhancement
What it means: UX gate before first use.

Trigger: User picks emoji for a word (e.g. from picker)
What it executes: addEmoji(...) — push emoji element into existing section or create new section with one emoji segment; set preference enableEmoji: true
What it means: Adds emoji to caption word on emoji track.

Trigger: User replaces emoji in picker
What it executes: replaceEmoji(id, newSourceUri) — find emoji by id, update sourceUri
What it means: Updates emoji asset for that word.

Trigger: User removes emoji from word
What it executes: deleteEmoji(id) — find section containing emoji, call delete() on element
What it means: Removes emoji from track.

Trigger: Captions change (e.g. word removed)
What it executes: syncEmojiInOut — keep emoji segments in sync with caption segments; remove orphans
What it means: Keeps emoji track aligned with captions.

Trigger: User chooses highlight color (Default Highlight 1 etc.) on a word
What it executes: Caption track / preference update for word color; editor.caption.operation with corresponding firstOperation
What it means: Sets word's highlight color; rendering uses enableHighlight and word color.

Trigger: User toggles AI keywords highlighter checkbox
What it executes: onUpdateExpectedPref then a({ enableHighlight: e }); no dedicated analytics
What it means: Preference only; controls whether highlight colors are used.

Trigger: User changes a speaker's color in color picker
What it executes: updateSpeaker(speakerId, color) — update preference.speakersColor, dispatch to S.R.speakersColor and preference
What it means: Updates speaker color for caption rendering when speaker detection is on.

Trigger: User applies change speaker (apply to all / switch / single segment)
What it executes: Handlers update caption words' speaker assignment and optionally swap colors; push editor.speaker_color.change_speaker with apply_all switch_speaker
What it means: Changes which speaker is assigned to word(s).
